title: Quran vs Science: Who Explains Creation Better?
tags: Adam and Eve in Quran explained
description:
What’s really inside the Quran? Most people — including many Muslims — have never read it cover to cover. In this documentary, Pale Blue Thoughts takes you through the essence of Islam: its origins, contradictions, and the story it tells about Allah, Muhammad, angels, jinns, and humanity.

We explore how the Quran begins with Allah sitting on a throne above water, how he creates Adam from dust, demands angels bow down, and casts out Iblis (Satan) for refusing. We see how contradictions arise: creation in 6 days, or 6000 years, or 300,000 years? Why an all-powerful God needs to experiment, test, and demand constant praise.

From Adam and Eve’s exile to the story of Qabil and Habil (Cain and Abel), to the peculiar purpose of creation — not out of love, but to fill Hell with humans and jinns — the Quran offers a worldview full of paradoxes. We also look at promises of heaven with milk, honey, virgins, and servant boys, and eternal hellfire where God recreates skin endlessly so it can burn again.

Finally, we trace Islam’s historical roots: Muhammad’s claim to prophethood, his 13 years of rejection in Mecca, the migration to Medina, and the wars that led to the destruction of 360 pagan idols. By the time of his death in 632 CE, he had consolidated Arabia under the banner of one God, reshaping history.

If you’ve searched for Quran explained, origins of Islam, Muhammad history, Islamic contradictions, or what the Quran really says, this video breaks it all down in plain language.
